topic: Someone finds their childhood teddy bear at a yard sale
text: I suppose I should have felt a surge of nostalgia, or perhaps a twinge of joy, upon finding my old teddy bear at a yard sale. Instead, I felt a peculiar heaviness, a mix of memories and an unspoken debt. This worn-out bear, once the silent keeper of my secrets, now seemed a testament to a time when life was simpler, when fears and sorrows could be confided in a soft, wooden-buttoned ear. Yet, here it was, cast aside, reduced to a yard sale item. I held it, its fur threadbare and eyes dim, and wondered if I had any right to reclaim it, to bring it back into a life that was now so different from the one it knew.
